name: rds_process_failure

query_condition.sql: SELECT node, service, run_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sequence) AS failures FROM rds_events WHERE event = 'process_failed' GROUP BY node, service, run_id

row_template: {node} {service} run={run_id} failed; inspect correlated events and local private diagnostics.
description: A polled RDS process future returned an error. Does not cover SIGKILL, abort or host loss; independent liveness checks are required.

name: rds_telemetry_loss

query_condition.sql: SELECT node, service, run_id, MAX(telemetry_dropped_total) AS dropped, MAX(telemetry_oversize_total) AS oversized, MAX(telemetry_write_errors_total) AS write_errors FROM rds_events GROUP BY node, service, run_id HAVING MAX(telemetry_dropped_total) > 0 OR MAX(telemetry_oversize_total) > 0 OR MAX(telemetry_write_errors_total) > 0

row_template: {node} {service} run={run_id}: dropped={dropped} oversized={oversized} output_errors={write_errors}; check collector and disk before interpreting rates.
description: Cumulative loss during a process run. Repeats after silence while that run reports loss; total output failure requires independent liveness monitoring.

name: rds_connect_errors

query_condition.sql: SELECT node, service, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures FROM (SELECT DISTINCT node, service, run_id, sequence, outcome FROM rds_events WHERE event = 'operation_completed' AND operation = 'connect' AND outcome IN ('ok', 'error')) GROUP BY node, service HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 AND SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 5 >= COUNT(*)

row_template: {node} {service}: {failures} failures in {attempts} observed connects; inspect discovery, policy and path evidence.
description: At least ten observed connect attempts with at least 20 percent errors in five minutes. Excludes cancellations; log delivery is best effort, so this is not an SLO counter.
